description: Per-sequence acquisition constants for the Space-Tracker release, keyed '<half>/<sequence name>'. gsd_m is ground sample distance in metres, fps the acquisition frame rate. Each carries a provenance tag: 'paper' (stated by the source publication), 'derived' (measured from the distributed files, e.g. SDM-Car's rate read out of its AVI containers), 'inherited' (propagated from a matched parent scene whose dataset publishes the constant), or 'unverified' (not establishable; the value is null). OOTB and SatSOT mix imaging platforms and publish no per-sequence table, which is why parts of the SOT half are null.

fields.platform: imaging platform(s) named by the source dataset
fields.gsd_m: ground sample distance in metres, or null
fields.note: caveat attached by the source dataset, where one applies
